_provenance: Hierarchy labels follow the NPClassifier three-level scheme (pathway > superclass > class; Kim et al., J. Nat. Prod. 2021, 84, 2795). Descriptions are curated summaries for this demo.

Alkaloids.description: Nitrogen-containing metabolites, most derived from amino acids (ornithine, lysine, tyrosine, tryptophan, anthranilate) or, for pseudoalkaloids, from nitrogen introduced late onto terpenoid/polyketide/purine skeletons.

Shikimates and Phenylpropanoids.description: Aromatic metabolites from the shikimate pathway (phosphoenolpyruvate + erythrose-4-phosphate), mostly through phenylalanine/cinnamic acid; includes flavonoids, stilbenes and coumarins that also incorporate malonyl-CoA.

Terpenoids.description: Isoprenoids assembled from C5 units (IPP/DMAPP) produced by the mevalonate or MEP pathways: C10 monoterpenoids, C15 sesquiterpenoids, C20 diterpenoids, C30 triterpenoids and steroids.

Polyketides.description: Built by polyketide synthases from acyl-CoA starters and malonyl-CoA extender units with variable reduction; includes aromatic polyketides, macrolides, polyethers and reduced fungal polyketides.

Amino acids and Peptides.description: Ribosomal (RiPPs) and non-ribosomal peptides, β-lactams and modified amino acids.

Fatty acids.description: Fatty acids, oxylipins, fatty amides and related lipids from fatty acid synthase.

Carbohydrates.description: Mono-, oligo- and polysaccharides, aminoglycosides and related sugar derivatives.

superclasses.Pseudoalkaloids: Alkaloids whose carbon skeleton is not amino-acid-derived; nitrogen is introduced by transamination or comes from a purine.
superclasses.Nicotinic acid alkaloids: Alkaloids incorporating a pyridine ring from nicotinic acid.
superclasses.Tyrosine alkaloids: Tyrosine/DOPA-derived alkaloids including benzylisoquinolines, morphinans and protoberberines.
superclasses.Tryptophan alkaloids: Tryptophan/tryptamine-derived alkaloids, including β-carbolines and monoterpenoid indole alkaloids.
superclasses.Ornithine alkaloids: Pyrrolidine and tropane alkaloids from ornithine via putrescine.
superclasses.Lysine alkaloids: Piperidine, quinolizidine and indolizidine alkaloids from lysine via cadaverine.
superclasses.Phenylalanine-derived alkaloids: Amines derived from phenylalanine, including ephedra alkaloids.
superclasses.Flavonoids: C6–C3–C6 compounds from a chalcone formed by chalcone synthase (p-coumaroyl-CoA + 3 malonyl-CoA).
superclasses.Diarylheptanoids: Two aryl groups linked by a seven-carbon chain, formed by type III PKSs.
superclasses.Stilbenoids: C6–C2–C6 compounds formed by stilbene synthase.
superclasses.Coumarins: Benzo-α-pyrones from ortho-hydroxylation and lactonisation of cinnamic acids.
superclasses.Phenylpropanoids (C6-C3): Simple C6–C3 units: cinnamic acids, aldehydes, alcohols, phenylpropenes and their esters.
superclasses.beta-Lactams: Antibiotics containing a four-membered azetidinone ring.
superclasses.Oligopeptides: Short peptides, frequently non-ribosomal and heavily modified.
superclasses.Reduced polyketides: Polyketides with extensive β-keto reduction, e.g. fungal decalin polyketides.
superclasses.Aromatic polyketides: Poly-β-keto chains cyclised to aromatic rings without full reduction.

classes.Purine alkaloids: Methylated xanthines derived from purine nucleotides.
classes.Morphinan alkaloids: Pentacyclic alkaloids with the morphinan skeleton formed by phenol coupling of reticuline.
classes.Quinoline alkaloids: Alkaloids with a quinoline ring, often from rearranged indole precursors.
classes.Protoberberine alkaloids: Tetracyclic alkaloids formed by the berberine bridge.
classes.beta-Carboline alkaloids: Pyrido[3,4-b]indoles from Pictet–Spengler cyclisation of tryptamine.
classes.Flavan-3-ols: Reduced flavonoids lacking the C4 carbonyl; catechins.
classes.Caryophyllane sesquiterpenoids: Bicyclic sesquiterpenoids with fused 4- and 9-membered rings.
classes.Cadinane sesquiterpenoids: Bicyclic decalin sesquiterpenoids of the cadinane/amorphane type.
classes.Abietane diterpenoids: Tricyclic diterpenoids with the abietane skeleton.
classes.Taxane diterpenoids: Diterpenoids with the 6-8-6 taxane ring system.
classes.Furocoumarins: Coumarins with a fused furan ring.
classes.Penicillins: β-Lactams fused to a thiazolidine ring.
classes.Anthraquinones and anthrones: Tricyclic aromatic polyketides with a 9,10-anthracenedione or anthrone core.
